name: 20’ Tube Display Straight
descriptionHtml:
Download Template

https://displaytemplate.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/Fabric+Display+Image/Fabric+Display.zip https://displaytemplate.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/Product+setup+instruction/Inst_256239-256241_8FT+EUROFIT+Wall+Displays.pdf

Features:
This display is approximately 90" tall
Your artwork will be dye sublimated on polyester knit
Double-sided graphic cover is viewable from both the front and back of the display
Graphic cover slips over the frame like a pillowcase
Fabric contours to the frame for a form-fitted look
Lightweight aluminum frame
Joints are labeled for step-by-step frame assembly
Push-button connectors make it easy to assemble
Slim swivel feet allow Walls to be paired at angles
Imprint Method: Full-Color Dye Sublimation

Materials
Graphic: Polyester Knit
Hardware: Aluminum
Carry Case: 600 Denier Polyester

Primary Usage
Indoor

Order Cutoff Time
12:00 PM Central Daylight Time

3 Easy Steps

Step 1: Shop 🛒

Pick your products and add-ons, then add your order to the cart.

Step 2: Payment 💳

Go to your cart and choose your payment option:

Full payment: your design gets priority 🚀

Deposit: start the design now and pay the remaining balance after artwork approval

(Deposit option applies only to orders over $295 USD. Orders below this amount require full payment.)

Step 3: Artwork 🎨

Complete checkout and upload your artwork using the provided link.

Don’t see it? No worries — we’ll email it to you.
